title: Filtering and sorting todos
prompt:
The task board needs filtering and sorting, and we've agreed on the design in docs/query.md. Please build it:

1. In src/todos.ts, export the TodoQuery interface described there and add TodoService.query(query?: TodoQuery): Todo[] with the filters (status, tags, text, dueBefore), the sort keys and order, the rules for todos without a due date and for ties, and the RangeError validation, all exactly as the doc says.
2. In src/http.ts, make handleTodos read the query-string parameters listed in the doc (status, repeated tag, q, dueBefore, sort, order) and answer with { status: 200, body: { items, count } }, or { status: 400, body: { error } } when a value is invalid. Unknown parameters are ignored and GET /todos with no parameters must keep returning every todo in id order.

The existing behaviour of add, complete and list stays as it is.
acceptance: Defaults; status/tags (all, case-insensitive)/text (trimmed)/dueBefore (inclusive, null excluded) filters and combinations; sort by id/created/due/title with asc/desc, null due last in both orders, ties by id ascending; RangeError for bad status/sort/order/dates incl. impossible dates; list() not reordered; HTTP parameter mapping with repeated and empty tag values, unknown params ignored, 400 with error string.
difficulty_rationale: Two files and a spec with several interacting edge cases (nulls last in both orders, tie-breaks, inclusive date bound, calendar validation, query-string mapping).
